verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management tool, so AI triage of incoming bugs and tasks is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no built-in AI feature that triages or prioritizes work items. The REST API and MCP server are developer building blocks that external agents could use to build triage. The pricing-page automations (auto-start/complete Epics, roll over Iterations) and manual Iteration prioritization are adjacent features, not AI triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
